page.layout: Top centre: two medallion engravings side by side (left: Macrianus, crowned, facing right; right: Macrianus senior, turbaned, bearded, facing left), each with its legend around the rim. Below them one block of running text in one column, with one italic passage inside the first paragraph. No notes in the margins, no text below the text block.

page.notes: Medallion legends are partly cut off by the rim: left coin reads "SEN.AVG" and "MACRIANVS"; right coin reads "NVS IMP" (first letters cut off, marked [?]) and "MACRIA". Printed "4 5 0 0 0" was set with gaps; copied as 45000. Tilde and macron abbreviations (militũ, Gallienũ, cõtra, ite, Dominitianus) are kept as printed. Faint text at the bottom of the page is show-through from the reverse and is left out. Long s was read as s and the printed intereptus was copied with its spelling.
